title: farever-combat-log v1
description: One line of a farever-combat-log v1 file (JSON Lines, UTF-8, optionally gzip). Line 1 is a header (#/$defs/header); every following line is an event (#/$defs/event). Ids are CastleDB row ids from the game's data.cdb. See docs/COMBAT-LOG.md.

uid.description: A unit or object uid, as a JSON string. Decimal digits are best: the bench writes a target as <unit>#<uid>.

steamBuild.description: The Steam build id (buildid in appmanifest_3672400.acf).

bootSha256.description: sha256 of the hlboot.dat the game ran from. SHOULD be written: it is the only build identity the bench can hold against an install.

recordsPresses.description: true: the log writes a press for every press of the character, so a window with none is one in which nothing was pressed.

startedAt.description: Epoch MILLISECONDS of time 0 (2001-2286). Epoch seconds are refused.

startedAtEstimated.description: true when startedAt was worked out, not observed.

me.description: The uid of the character the log is for, as the events write it.

class.description: Unit id (Warrior, Rogue, Mage, Priest) or aptitude id (Fighter, Assassin, Wizard, Cleric), any case.

bossKind.description: Unit id of the boss or target.

difficulty.description: ActivityDifficulty: 0 Normal, 1 Veteran, 2 Heroic, -1 unknown. The case names are read too, in any case.

initial.description: Events standing at time 0: statuses already up, as status_present.

count.description: The number of event lines; must match when present.

initialEvent.description: An event of header.initial: as an event, with time optional. An entry without one stands at 0, or at the first event's time when the file opens earlier (a lead-in).

time.description: Seconds from startedAt; may be negative inside a lead-in. An event further than 10,000,000 s from startedAt is skipped.

source.description: Who did it; a pet's hit names its owner.

target.description: Who it happened to; for a status, who wears it.

skill.description: CastleDB id of what produced the event: a status id for its ticks, the pet's own skill for a pet swing. The join key.

origin.description: CastleDB id of the parent skill.

instance.description: uid of the skill or status object; not the target's instance.

outcome.description: On damage: Hit, Blocked or the blocker's id. On avoided: DamageDodge or InvulnerableHit. On status_removed: the reason.

duration.description: A status's time left in seconds, -1 when it has no clock.

related.description: seq of the use event this one belongs to.

sourceKind.description: Bench addition: unit id of the source after owner attribution.

affinity.description: Bench addition: the hit's affinity id; never derived from damageType.

summoned.description: Bench addition: a pet of source dealt it.

spark.description: Bench addition: on a press, skill_use or block_use of the character, its Spark at that moment.

rage.description: Bench addition: on a press, skill_use or block_use of the character, its Rage at that moment.
